description:
Use this when the user asks what ready-made screens are available, before calling run_preset_screen.

Returns the ready-made screens, each with a description and the time its result was last computed: low_price_to_earnings, high_dividend_yield_large_market_cap, low_leverage_high_roe, high_promoter_holding_low_pledge and high_growth_latest_results. It takes no arguments. Run one with run_preset_screen; for your own conditions use screen_stocks.
name: list_preset_screens
title: Preset screens
